title: Data movement is the new performance battleground in semiconductor design
excerpt: The next breakthrough in AI starts with moving data faster
content_html:
For much of the semiconductor industry’s history, performance debates have centered on compute throughput and memory capacity. Faster processors, wider vectors, and larger caches have been the primary levers for system architects, often treating the movement of data between them as a secondary concern.

Today, a different constraint is asserting itself as AI data center workloads proliferate, architectures diversify, and systems extend beyond traditional computing into the physical world. Data movement, rather than processing or storage, is increasingly defining the limits of performance, power efficiency, predictability, determinism, and scalability.

VP of Product Management and Marketing at Arteris.

This shift around data movement is already visible. Across applications like advanced SoCs, AI accelerators, chiplet-based systems, and now in physical AI applications such as robotics, industrial automation, and intelligent vehicles, it has become clear that transporting the vast quantities of data required by such workloads is more demanding than processing them.

Physical AI does not introduce a new problem so much as it exposes an existing one: when systems must perceive, decide, and act in closed loops under real-time and safety constraints, inefficient or unpredictable data movement quickly becomes the dominant bottleneck.

The implications for both AI in the data center and physical AI extend far beyond any single market. As data center demand increases exponentially and the industry pushes toward increasingly complex, heterogeneous systems in anything from vehicles to industrial systems, data movement has become the primary performance battleground.

Performance limits are increasingly defined by data movement

Modern semiconductor systems integrate an unprecedented number of processing elements, including general-purpose CPUs, AI accelerators, GPUs, DSPs, sensor processors, and domain-specific engines. Still, simply adding compute resources rarely delivers proportional gains. In many advanced designs, performance plateaus long before compute capacity is exhausted.

Compute units are left sitting idle not because they lack capability, but because data cannot reach them efficiently or predictably. Late-stage analysis of high-performance SoCs often reveals that throughput shortfalls stem from contention, imbalanced bandwidth allocation, or inefficient routing within the communication fabric, rather than from compute limitations.

This is especially visible in physical AI systems, where delays introduced by data movement propagate directly into system behavior in closed-loop architectures. Latency or contention in the transport fabric can destabilize control algorithms, reduce accuracy, and even force over-provisioning of compute to compensate for the absence of bounded latency and guaranteed behavior.

While physical AI makes data movement constraints more immediately visible, the same forces are amplified dramatically in the data center. To push enormous volumes of data through extremely wide interfaces, processors increasingly contain hundreds of compute and accelerator instances, press against reticle-scale integration limits, use chiplet-based designs, and interface with multiple stacks of high-bandwidth memory (HBM).

As designs scale, the combined costs of moving data grow rapidly. In this environment, abundant compute and memory bandwidth offer little benefit without a data movement architecture capable of managing data at scale. What is a tight constraint in physical AI becomes an overwhelming one in the data center.

In both the AI data center and physical AI, performance is inseparable from the behavior of the data paths that connect perception, decision, and actuation. As a result, interconnect design can no longer be a back-end integration task. It has become a central architectural decision, on equal footing with compute and memory selection.

On-chip data movement is fundamentally different

Data movement inside a chip operates under constraints that differ radically from those of off-chip networking or board-level interconnect. On-chip transfers are extremely frequent, tightly synchronized with execution, and subject to stringent latency and power budgets.

Traffic is also inherently heterogeneous. A single system may need to carry high-bandwidth AI data streams, cache and coherency traffic, latency-critical control messages, and safety-related signaling, often simultaneously. These flows have very different requirements and cannot be treated uniformly.

Traditional best-effort arbitration models break down quickly under these conditions. Bursty accelerator traffic can interfere with control-plane and real-time data paths, leading to unpredictable system behavior. In mission and safety-critical or physical AI applications, such interference is unacceptable.

As a result, quality of service (QoS), traffic isolation, bounded latency, and determinism are now architectural requirements, not just optional optimizations. The interconnect fabric increasingly functions as an active system component, enforcing policy and guaranteeing behavior, rather than as a passive conduit for bits.

AI, heterogeneity, and physical intelligence magnify the challenge

AI workloads fundamentally change the character of data movement. They generate massive data volumes, irregular access patterns, and asymmetric traffic flows. At the same time, heterogeneous architectures distribute computation across many specialized engines, eliminating any single “center” of the system.

In both data center and edge contexts, this decentralization increases coordination costs. Data replication, synchronization overhead, and inefficient sharing can consume significant power and latency, eroding the benefits of specialized compute. Rather than compute placement, the challenge designers face now lies in how to efficiently orchestrate data movement between diverse compute elements.

Physical AI places additional pressure on these architectures. Unlike batch or best-effort inference workloads, physical systems operate continuously in real time. Sensor data must be ingested, processed, and acted upon within strict deadlines. Feedback loops amplify even small inefficiencies in data movement.

Together, these demands reinforce the broader lesson that heterogeneity without a deliberate data movement architecture leads to complexity and inefficiency, not scalability.

Chiplets turn data movement into a system-level design problem

Chiplet-based multi-die architectures promise yield advantages, faster innovation cycles, and importantly, flexibility. But they also elevate data movement challenges beyond a single piece of silicon.

Cross-die communication introduces higher energy per bit, tighter physical and architectural constraints, and more extra latency than on-die data movement. Interfaces that were trivial within a single die become critical bottlenecks once they must traverse package boundaries.

Successful chiplet systems, therefore, require system-level planning of data movement, encompassing topology, hierarchy, coherency and protocol selection, and physical constraints. Partitioning functionality without an integrated strategy for how data flows between partitions often increases, rather than reduces, overall system complexity.

Control and safety domains may span multiple dies, and failures or delays in inter-die communication directly affect system behavior. Chiplets demand not only modular compute but also modular, predictable connectivity.

Deliberate data movement is a strategic differentiator

Across markets, a clear divide is emerging. Teams that treat data movement as an incidental consequence of integration struggle with rising complexity, unpredictable performance, and costly late-stage redesigns. Those who deliberately architect data movement gain sustained advantages.

Deliberate data movement architecture enables a host of benefits. Bottlenecks in latency, bandwidth, and power can be identified early; system architectures can be made easily repeatable across product generations; and architectural intent, software behavior and physical implementation can be correlated much more closely and reliably.

Additionally, it better enables teams to explore the tradeoffs between alternative floorplans and interconnect topologies (as well as logical & physical partitioning of multi-die products) well before physical constraints harden.

Achieving this at scale increasingly requires automation that is physically aware, yet architect controlled. Modern approaches synthesize interconnect structures directly from connectivity, traffic, and layout constraints, while allowing designers to intervene and iterate rapidly. The goal is not to hide complexity, but to make it tractable.

Equally important is the generation of consistent architectural, software, verification, and implementation views from a unified system description. This top-down correlation reduces mismatch between intent and realization, helping to minimize risk and accelerate time to market.

The new battleground

As systems extend into the physical world, while architectures grow more complex to keep pace with expanding AI workloads the semiconductor industry is entering a new phase. Performance, power, safety, and scalability are no longer determined primarily by how fast data can be processed, but by how intelligently, efficiently, and predictably it can be moved.

Physical AI makes this reality impossible to ignore, but the lesson applies broadly, from data centers to embedded systems. The invisible highways inside chips have become the decisive terrain on which competitive advantage is won or lost. In this environment, data movement is no longer simple plumbing. It is the battleground where the next generation of semiconductor systems will succeed - or fail.

blocks.html_en: As a result, quality of service (QoS), traffic isolation, bounded latency, and determinism are now architectural requirements, not just optional optimizations. The interconnect fabric increasingly functions as an active system component, enforcing policy and guaranteeing behavior, rather than as a passive conduit for bits.

sentences.en: As a result, quality of service (QoS), traffic isolation, bounded latency, and determinism are now architectural requirements, not just optional optimizations.
sentences.zh: 因此，服务质量 (QoS)、流量隔离、有限延迟和确定性现在已成为架构要求，而不仅仅是可选的优化。

sentences.en: The interconnect fabric increasingly functions as an active system component, enforcing policy and guaranteeing behavior, rather than as a passive conduit for bits.
sentences.zh: 互连结构越来越多地充当主动系统组件，执行策略并保证行为，而不是充当比特的被动管道。

blocks.html_en: AI, heterogeneity, and physical intelligence magnify the challenge

sentences.en: AI, heterogeneity, and physical intelligence magnify the challenge
sentences.zh: 人工智能、异质性和物理智能放大了挑战

blocks.html_en: AI workloads fundamentally change the character of data movement. They generate massive data volumes, irregular access patterns, and asymmetric traffic flows. At the same time, heterogeneous architectures distribute computation across many specialized engines, eliminating any single “center” of the system.

sentences.en: AI workloads fundamentally change the character of data movement.
sentences.zh: 人工智能工作负载从根本上改变了数据移动的特征。

sentences.en: They generate massive data volumes, irregular access patterns, and asymmetric traffic flows.
sentences.zh: 它们产生大量数据、不规则的访问模式和不对称的流量。

sentences.en: At the same time, heterogeneous architectures distribute computation across many specialized engines, eliminating any single “center” of the system.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，异构架构将计算分布在许多专用引擎上，消除了系统的任何单一“中心”。

blocks.html_en: In both data center and edge contexts, this decentralization increases coordination costs. Data replication, synchronization overhead, and inefficient sharing can consume significant power and latency, eroding the benefits of specialized compute. Rather than compute placement, the challenge designers face now lies in how to efficiently orchestrate data movement between diverse compute elements.

sentences.en: In both data center and edge contexts, this decentralization increases coordination costs.
sentences.zh: 在数据中心和边缘环境中，这种去中心化都会增加协调成本。

sentences.en: Data replication, synchronization overhead, and inefficient sharing can consume significant power and latency, eroding the benefits of specialized compute.
sentences.zh: 数据复制、同步开销和低效共享会消耗大量电量和延迟，从而削弱专业计算的优势。

sentences.en: Rather than compute placement, the challenge designers face now lies in how to efficiently orchestrate data movement between diverse compute elements.
sentences.zh: 设计人员现在面临的挑战不是计算布局，而是如何有效地协调不同计算元素之间的数据移动。

blocks.html_en: Physical AI places additional pressure on these architectures. Unlike batch or best-effort inference workloads, physical systems operate continuously in real time. Sensor data must be ingested, processed, and acted upon within strict deadlines. Feedback loops amplify even small inefficiencies in data movement.

sentences.en: Physical AI places additional pressure on these architectures.
sentences.zh: 物理人工智能给这些架构带来了额外的压力。

sentences.en: Unlike batch or best-effort inference workloads, physical systems operate continuously in real time.
sentences.zh: 与批量或尽力推理工作负载不同，物理系统实时连续运行。

sentences.en: Sensor data must be ingested, processed, and acted upon within strict deadlines.
sentences.zh: 传感器数据必须在严格的期限内摄取、处理和采取行动。

sentences.en: Feedback loops amplify even small inefficiencies in data movement.
sentences.zh: 反馈循环甚至会放大数据移动中微小的低效率。

blocks.html_en: Together, these demands reinforce the broader lesson that heterogeneity without a deliberate data movement architecture leads to complexity and inefficiency, not scalability.

sentences.en: Together, these demands reinforce the broader lesson that heterogeneity without a deliberate data movement architecture leads to complexity and inefficiency, not scalability.
sentences.zh: 这些需求共同强化了一个更广泛的教训：如果没有经过深思熟虑的数据移动架构，异构性会导致复杂性和低效率，而不是可扩展性。

blocks.html_en: Chiplets turn data movement into a system-level design problem

sentences.en: Chiplets turn data movement into a system-level design problem
sentences.zh: Chiplet 将数据移动转变为系统级设计问题

blocks.html_en: Chiplet-based multi-die architectures promise yield advantages, faster innovation cycles, and importantly, flexibility. But they also elevate data movement challenges beyond a single piece of silicon.

sentences.en: Chiplet-based multi-die architectures promise yield advantages, faster innovation cycles, and importantly, flexibility.
sentences.zh: 基于 Chiplet 的多芯片架构有望带来良率优势、更快的创新周期，以及重要的是灵活性。

sentences.en: But they also elevate data movement challenges beyond a single piece of silicon.
sentences.zh: 但它们也使数据移动挑战超出了单块芯片的范围。

blocks.html_en: Cross-die communication introduces higher energy per bit, tighter physical and architectural constraints, and more extra latency than on-die data movement. Interfaces that were trivial within a single die become critical bottlenecks once they must traverse package boundaries.

sentences.en: Cross-die communication introduces higher energy per bit, tighter physical and architectural constraints, and more extra latency than on-die data movement.
sentences.zh: 与芯片内数据移动相比，跨芯片通信引入了更高的每比特能量、更严格的物理和架构约束以及更多的额外延迟。

sentences.en: Interfaces that were trivial within a single die become critical bottlenecks once they must traverse package boundaries.
sentences.zh: 一旦必须穿越封装边界，单个芯片中微不足道的接口就会成为关键瓶颈。

blocks.html_en: Successful chiplet systems, therefore, require system-level planning of data movement, encompassing topology, hierarchy, coherency and protocol selection, and physical constraints. Partitioning functionality without an integrated strategy for how data flows between partitions often increases, rather than reduces, overall system complexity.

sentences.en: Successful chiplet systems, therefore, require system-level planning of data movement, encompassing topology, hierarchy, coherency and protocol selection, and physical constraints.
sentences.zh: 因此，成功的小芯片系统需要对数据移动进行系统级规划，包括拓扑、层次结构、一致性和协议选择以及物理约束。

sentences.en: Partitioning functionality without an integrated strategy for how data flows between partitions often increases, rather than reduces, overall system complexity.
sentences.zh: 没有针对数据在分区之间如何流动的集成策略的分区功能通常会增加而不是降低整个系统的复杂性。

blocks.html_en: Control and safety domains may span multiple dies, and failures or delays in inter-die communication directly affect system behavior. Chiplets demand not only modular compute but also modular, predictable connectivity.

sentences.en: Control and safety domains may span multiple dies, and failures or delays in inter-die communication directly affect system behavior.
sentences.zh: 控制和安全域可能跨越多个芯片，芯片间通信的故障或延迟直接影响系统行为。

sentences.en: Chiplets demand not only modular compute but also modular, predictable connectivity.
sentences.zh: Chiplet 不仅需要模块化计算，还需要模块化、可预测的连接。

blocks.html_en: Deliberate data movement is a strategic differentiator

sentences.en: Deliberate data movement is a strategic differentiator
sentences.zh: 有意的数据移动是一个战略差异化因素

blocks.html_en: Across markets, a clear divide is emerging. Teams that treat data movement as an incidental consequence of integration struggle with rising complexity, unpredictable performance, and costly late-stage redesigns. Those who deliberately architect data movement gain sustained advantages.

sentences.en: Across markets, a clear divide is emerging.
sentences.zh: 各个市场之间正在出现明显的分歧。

sentences.en: Teams that treat data movement as an incidental consequence of integration struggle with rising complexity, unpredictable performance, and costly late-stage redesigns.
sentences.zh: 将数据移动视为集成的偶然结果的团队面临着不断增加的复杂性、不可预测的性能和昂贵的后期重新设计的困难。

sentences.en: Those who deliberately architect data movement gain sustained advantages.
sentences.zh: 那些有意设计数据移动的人可以获得持续的优势。

blocks.html_en: Deliberate data movement architecture enables a host of benefits. Bottlenecks in latency, bandwidth, and power can be identified early; system architectures can be made easily repeatable across product generations; and architectural intent, software behavior and physical implementation can be correlated much more closely and reliably.

sentences.en: Deliberate data movement architecture enables a host of benefits.
sentences.zh: 精心设计的数据移动架构可以带来许多好处。

sentences.en: Bottlenecks in latency, bandwidth, and power can be identified early; system architectures can be made easily repeatable across product generations; and architectural intent, software behavior and physical implementation can be correlated much more closely and reliably.
sentences.zh: 可以及早发现延迟、带宽和功耗方面的瓶颈；系统架构可以在各代产品之间轻松重复；架构意图、软件行为和物理实现可以更紧密、更可靠地关联起来。

blocks.html_en: Additionally, it better enables teams to explore the tradeoffs between alternative floorplans and interconnect topologies (as well as logical & physical partitioning of multi-die products) well before physical constraints harden.

sentences.en: Additionally, it better enables teams to explore the tradeoffs between alternative floorplans and interconnect topologies (as well as logical & physical partitioning of multi-die products) well before physical constraints harden.
sentences.zh: 此外，它还可以更好地使团队在物理约束强化之前探索替代布局规划和互连拓扑（以及多芯片产品的逻辑和物理分区）之间的权衡。

blocks.html_en: Achieving this at scale increasingly requires automation that is physically aware, yet architect controlled. Modern approaches synthesize interconnect structures directly from connectivity, traffic, and layout constraints, while allowing designers to intervene and iterate rapidly. The goal is not to hide complexity, but to make it tractable.

sentences.en: Achieving this at scale increasingly requires automation that is physically aware, yet architect controlled.
sentences.zh: 大规模实现这一目标越来越需要物理感知但架构师控制的自动化。

sentences.en: Modern approaches synthesize interconnect structures directly from connectivity, traffic, and layout constraints, while allowing designers to intervene and iterate rapidly.
sentences.zh: 现代方法直接根据连接性、流量和布局约束合成互连结构，同时允许设计人员快速干预和迭代。

sentences.en: The goal is not to hide complexity, but to make it tractable.
sentences.zh: 目标不是隐藏复杂性，而是使其易于处理。

blocks.html_en: Equally important is the generation of consistent architectural, software, verification, and implementation views from a unified system description. This top-down correlation reduces mismatch between intent and realization, helping to minimize risk and accelerate time to market.

sentences.en: Equally important is the generation of consistent architectural, software, verification, and implementation views from a unified system description.
sentences.zh: 同样重要的是从统一的系统描述生成一致的架构、软件、验证和实现视图。

sentences.en: This top-down correlation reduces mismatch between intent and realization, helping to minimize risk and accelerate time to market.
sentences.zh: 这种自上而下的相关性减少了意图与实现之间的不匹配，有助于最大限度地降低风险并加快上市时间。

blocks.html_en: The new battleground

sentences.en: The new battleground
sentences.zh: 新战场

blocks.html_en: As systems extend into the physical world, while architectures grow more complex to keep pace with expanding AI workloads the semiconductor industry is entering a new phase. Performance, power, safety, and scalability are no longer determined primarily by how fast data can be processed, but by how intelligently, efficiently, and predictably it can be moved.

sentences.en: As systems extend into the physical world, while architectures grow more complex to keep pace with expanding AI workloads the semiconductor industry is entering a new phase.
sentences.zh: 随着系统扩展到物理世界，而架构变得越来越复杂以跟上不断扩大的人工智能工作负载的步伐，半导体行业正在进入一个新阶段。

sentences.en: Performance, power, safety, and scalability are no longer determined primarily by how fast data can be processed, but by how intelligently, efficiently, and predictably it can be moved.
sentences.zh: 性能、功耗、安全性和可扩展性不再主要取决于数据处理的速度，而是取决于数据移动的智能、高效和可预测程度。

blocks.html_en: Physical AI makes this reality impossible to ignore, but the lesson applies broadly, from data centers to embedded systems. The invisible highways inside chips have become the decisive terrain on which competitive advantage is won or lost. In this environment, data movement is no longer simple plumbing. It is the battleground where the next generation of semiconductor systems will succeed - or fail.

sentences.en: Physical AI makes this reality impossible to ignore, but the lesson applies broadly, from data centers to embedded systems.
sentences.zh: 物理人工智能使这一现实不容忽视，但这一教训广泛适用，从数据中心到嵌入式系统。

sentences.en: The invisible highways inside chips have become the decisive terrain on which competitive advantage is won or lost.

blocks.html_en: VP of Product Management and Marketing at Arteris.

sentences.en: VP of Product Management and Marketing at Arteris.
sentences.zh: Arteris 产品管理和营销副总裁。

content_html_zh:
在半导体行业的大部分历史中，性能争论都集中在计算吞吐量和内存容量上。 更快的处理器、更宽的向量和更大的缓存一直是系统架构师的主要杠杆，通常将它们之间的数据移动视为次要问题。

如今，随着人工智能数据中心工作负载激增、架构多样化以及系统从传统计算扩展到物理世界，一个不同的限制正在显现。 数据移动（而不是处理或存储）越来越多地定义了性能、功效、可预测性、确定性和可扩展性的限制。

Arteris 产品管理和营销副总裁。

这种围绕数据移动的转变已经显而易见。 在先进 SoC、人工智能加速器、基于小芯片的系统等应用中，以及现在在机器人、工业自动化和智能车辆等物理人工智能应用中，很明显，传输此类工作负载所需的大量数据比处理它们的要求更高。

物理人工智能并没有引入新问题，而是暴露了一个现有问题：当系统必须在实时和安全约束下以闭环方式感知、决策和行动时，低效或不可预测的数据移动很快就会成为主要瓶颈。

对数据中心人工智能和物理人工智能的影响远远超出任何单一市场。 随着数据中心需求呈指数级增长，以及行业向从车辆到工业系统等各种领域日益复杂的异构系统发展，数据移动已成为主要的性能战场。

性能限制越来越多地由数据移动决定

现代半导体系统集成了数量空前的处理元件，包括通用 CPU、AI 加速器、GPU、DSP、传感器处理器和特定领域引擎。 尽管如此，简单地添加计算资源很少能带来成比例的收益。 在许多先进设计中，早在计算能力耗尽之前，性能就已达到稳定状态。

计算单元闲置不是因为它们缺乏能力，而是因为数据无法有效或可预测地到达它们。 对高性能 SoC 的后期分析通常表明，吞吐量不足源于争用、带宽分配不平衡或通信结构内的低效路由，而不是计算限制。

订阅 TechRadar Pro 时事通讯，获取您的企业成功所需的所有热门新闻、观点、功能和指导！

这在物理人工智能系统中尤其明显，其中数据移动引入的延迟直接传播到闭环架构中的系统行为中。 传输结构中的延迟或争用可能会破坏控制算法的稳定性，降低准确性，甚至强制过度配置计算以弥补有限延迟和保证行为的缺失。

虽然物理人工智能使数据移动限制更加明显，但同样的力量在数据中心却被急剧放大。 为了通过极宽的接口推送大量数据，处理器越来越多地包含数百个计算和加速器实例，突破标线级集成限制，使用基于小芯片的设计，并与多个高带宽内存 (HBM) 堆栈连接。

随着设计规模的扩大，移动数据的综合成本迅速增长。 在这种环境中，如果没有能够大规模管理数据的数据移动架构，充足的计算和内存带宽几乎没有什么好处。 物理人工智能中的严格限制在数据中心中变成了压倒性的限制。

在人工智能数据中心和物理人工智能中，性能与连接感知、决策和驱动的数据路径的行为密不可分。 因此，互连设计不再是后端集成任务。 它已成为一个核心架构决策，与计算和内存选择同等重要。

片上数据移动根本不同

芯片内部的数据移动所受到的限制与片外网络或板级互连的限制截然不同。 片上传输极其频繁，与执行紧密同步，并且受到严格的延迟和功率预算的影响。

流量本质上也是异构的。 单个系统可能需要经常同时承载高带宽人工智能数据流、缓存和一致性流量、延迟关键控制消息以及安全相关信令。 这些流程有非常不同的要求，不能统一处理。

传统的尽力而为仲裁模型在这些条件下很快就会崩溃。 突发的加速器流量可能会干扰控制平面和实时数据路径，导致不可预测的系统行为。 在任务和安全关键型或物理人工智能应用中，这种干扰是不可接受的。

因此，服务质量 (QoS)、流量隔离、有限延迟和确定性现在已成为架构要求，而不仅仅是可选的优化。 互连结构越来越多地充当主动系统组件，执行策略并保证行为，而不是充当比特的被动管道。

人工智能、异质性和物理智能放大了挑战

人工智能工作负载从根本上改变了数据移动的特征。 它们产生大量数据、不规则的访问模式和不对称的流量。 与此同时，异构架构将计算分布在许多专用引擎上，消除了系统的任何单一“中心”。

在数据中心和边缘环境中，这种去中心化都会增加协调成本。 数据复制、同步开销和低效共享会消耗大量电量和延迟，从而削弱专业计算的优势。 设计人员现在面临的挑战不是计算布局，而是如何有效地协调不同计算元素之间的数据移动。

物理人工智能给这些架构带来了额外的压力。 与批量或尽力推理工作负载不同，物理系统实时连续运行。 传感器数据必须在严格的期限内摄取、处理和采取行动。 反馈循环甚至会放大数据移动中微小的低效率。

这些需求共同强化了一个更广泛的教训：如果没有经过深思熟虑的数据移动架构，异构性会导致复杂性和低效率，而不是可扩展性。

Chiplet 将数据移动转变为系统级设计问题

基于 Chiplet 的多芯片架构有望带来良率优势、更快的创新周期，以及重要的是灵活性。 但它们也使数据移动挑战超出了单块芯片的范围。

与芯片内数据移动相比，跨芯片通信引入了更高的每比特能量、更严格的物理和架构约束以及更多的额外延迟。 一旦必须穿越封装边界，单个芯片中微不足道的接口就会成为关键瓶颈。

因此，成功的小芯片系统需要对数据移动进行系统级规划，包括拓扑、层次结构、一致性和协议选择以及物理约束。 没有针对数据在分区之间如何流动的集成策略的分区功能通常会增加而不是降低整个系统的复杂性。

控制和安全域可能跨越多个芯片，芯片间通信的故障或延迟直接影响系统行为。 Chiplet 不仅需要模块化计算，还需要模块化、可预测的连接。

有意的数据移动是一个战略差异化因素

各个市场之间正在出现明显的分歧。 将数据移动视为集成的偶然结果的团队面临着不断增加的复杂性、不可预测的性能和昂贵的后期重新设计的困难。 那些有意设计数据移动的人可以获得持续的优势。

精心设计的数据移动架构可以带来许多好处。 可以及早发现延迟、带宽和功耗方面的瓶颈；系统架构可以在各代产品之间轻松重复；架构意图、软件行为和物理实现可以更紧密、更可靠地关联起来。

此外，它还可以更好地使团队在物理约束强化之前探索替代布局规划和互连拓扑（以及多芯片产品的逻辑和物理分区）之间的权衡。

大规模实现这一目标越来越需要物理感知但架构师控制的自动化。 现代方法直接根据连接性、流量和布局约束合成互连结构，同时允许设计人员快速干预和迭代。 目标不是隐藏复杂性，而是使其易于处理。

同样重要的是从统一的系统描述生成一致的架构、软件、验证和实现视图。 这种自上而下的相关性减少了意图与实现之间的不匹配，有助于最大限度地降低风险并加快上市时间。

新战场

随着系统扩展到物理世界，而架构变得越来越复杂以跟上不断扩大的人工智能工作负载的步伐，半导体行业正在进入一个新阶段。 性能、功耗、安全性和可扩展性不再主要取决于数据处理的速度，而是取决于数据移动的智能、高效和可预测程度。

物理人工智能使这一现实不容忽视，但这一教训广泛适用，从数据中心到嵌入式系统。 芯片内部看不见的高速公路已成为赢得或失去竞争优势的决定性地形。 在这种环境中，数据移动不再是简单的管道。 这是下一代半导体系统成功或失败的战场。
